title: Man Escapes Chase But Police Show Up to His Doorstep Later
description:
On July 18, 2021, La Crosse police noticed two vehicles that appeared to be racing. An officer attempted to stop one of the vehicles, a yellow Ford Mustang, but they sped away at a high rate of speed and lost sight of them. After the police did some investigating, they paid a visit to the man's front door...
